start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum herbs, shrubs aur trees ko group karenge. Aap plants ko kitna notice karte hain?

turns.reply: Koi baat nahi, Kabir. School garden mein ek chhota, naram-stem plant aur ek mota, hard-stem plant dekhiye—kaunsa alag lagega?
Kabir, sawaal unclear tha—maaf kijiye. Bas itna dekhiye: stem naram aur hara hai, ya hard aur woody?
Kabir, aapko yeh boring lag raha hai—chaliye game karte hain: picture, rapid challenge, ya plant-detective? Aap ek choose kijiye.
Theek hai, Kabir. Soft green stem usually herbs mein hota hai; hard woody stem shrubs aur trees mein. Screen par “hard woody stems” kis groups ke neeche hain?

turns.line: mujhe gussa aa raha hai, ye samajh nahi aa raha
turns.reply: Kabir, gussa side mein rakhte hain: stem ko ungli se sochiye—naram hara = herb; hard lakdi jaisa = shrub ya tree. Aap kaunsa pehchanenge?
Theek hai, Kabir, ab rest lijiye.
Aur unka stem… aap poora kijiye.

turns.board: Is a hibiscus (gudhal) plant a herb, a shrub or a tree?
turns.reply: Haan Kabir, main AI teacher hoon. Trees usually tall hote hain aur unka stem hard woody hota hai; shrubs ke stems kaise hote hain?
